name: ai.childpsychiatry/library
registry_description: Clinician-reviewed library on child psychiatric evaluation and medication decision-making.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.title: Search articles
tools.description: Search Psychiatry for Children's editorial corpus by query. Returns title, slug, summary, and URL for matching articles.

tools.name: list_articles
tools.title: List articles
tools.description: Paginated list of articles from Psychiatry for Children. Returns title, slug, summary, and URL.

tools.name: get_article
tools.title: Get article
tools.description: Fetch a single article from Psychiatry for Children by slug. Returns title, body content, author, clinical reviewer, citations, and metadata.

tools.name: cite_article
tools.title: Cite article
tools.description: Get a formatted citation for a Psychiatry for Children article. Supports AMA, APA, and Chicago styles.

tools.name: get_microsite_info
tools.title: About this microsite
tools.description: Identity and links for Psychiatry for Children: tagline, audience, focus, publisher, sponsor relationship to Emora Health, and key URLs.

tools.name: get_crisis_resources
tools.title: Get crisis resources
tools.description: Return the canonical 988 / 911 / Crisis Text Line payload. Surface this immediately whenever the user signals self-harm or imminent danger.
